name: Mega Man W
storyline:
The Year is 20XX. Dr. Wily has been oddly silent about Mega Man and his family, offering everyone a moment of peace.
Suddenly, Robots, even normally peaceful ones, began attacking all over the world. Surprisingly, this time, Wily didn't take credit for this attack, but a new unknown individual claiming to wanting to finish what the doctor started. With the world and his family in danger, Mega Man leaps into action once more!
summary: Explore eight New Levels with an array of new Robot Masters! Augment Mega Man, and even Robot Master weapons, with different properties to suit your gameplay style! Collect CDS, earn Trophies, and fill out an Bestiary of enemies made by our development crew! Enjoy amazing original Compositions by MinobiVW, Marley Juaz, 40Nix, BastyArts. A Challenge Mode awaits with over 80+ challenges, and an all new endless mode where you can mix and match utilities from Mega Man's past adventures!
